candidateObservation.note: Observed state only; not state mutation, activation or independent review.

pathCorrections.treatment: Ordinary input locator correction; no contract rewrite or blocker.

metadata.method: Read-only registry installation records, exact executable FileVersionInfo, named-process metadata, Get-Command metadata, installed package.json files. No runtime execution.

python.note: No inference about TD embedded Python.

os.note: Raw metadata labels only; no OS marketing-name normalization.

unavailableMetadata: GPU/driver/actual renderer/TD app.build/license feature availability NOT_VERIFIED

callableMetadata.nativeComputerApi: disabled by exposed CUA tool instructions
callableMetadata.execCommand: available; runtime launch not exercised/authorized in scout
callableMetadata.meaning: No specialized TD connector observed; no claim that a future reviewed fixture adapter is impossible.

sourceObservation.nativeProvider: No concrete native adapter found by bounded production/src inventory and HostIdentity/TargetSession/ArtifactPublication/InputValues/NativeDefinitions/PreviewSession/FencedArtifactReceiver/grape.host search.
sourceObservation.diffGuard: No diff output for inspected production/src/sdk/public-surface.ts and production/package.json at read; B01 files not mutated.
sourceObservation.binaryInventory: No .toe/.tox in normal nonignored rg listing under handoff and production. No broad/ignored/external directory scan.
sourceObservation.referenceExample: handoff/examples/minimal-host-adapter/README.md explicitly labels fake in-memory provider, not TD implementation.

requirements.entry: S01 host-free Graph/Editor exists. Explicit target/identity/authority branch can proceed without PD3/4 branches.
runtime: Use zero/one/multiple explicitly supplied candidates, matching/foreign identity, connect/switch/cancel/failure/reconnect and stale replies; preserve current valid target and canonical Graph. No arbitrary auto-adoption.

Verify real receiving-side authority, optional/default-off credential semantics, origin/action/size policy, {hostId,targetId,incarnation}, bindingId/graphId/loadId/epoch and fresh readback after reconnect.

Per declared static-web/Node/Electron profile, prove bootstrap and correct machine locality. Native Viewer and Native Parameters actual window effects only after their separate product decisions and isolated target authority.
gateTiming: G-PD-3: before cross-identity fallback policy is implemented
G-PD-4A/4B: before each native-window visibility/access policy
Real bootstrap/provider/permission evidence before claiming runtime support
requirements.independentWork: Application service registration, descriptor validation, exact-target lifecycle and no-provider UI tests; mocks remain bounded conformance only.

requirements.entry: S01 same-snapshot artifact/code/schema/document plus reviewed S07 target/authority/epoch. First real native feasibility before enlarging dependent publication.
runtime: Record actual TD build, OS, GPU/driver, host-affine execution/serialized commit boundary, native Par/OP identities, compiler diagnostics/line mapping, actual code/schema/document and revision readback.

Prepare A without changing active last-good; commit with receiving-side lease/intentSeq/expected revision recheck and compatible live values sampled at commit. Delay/reorder A/B/Undo and receipt responses; prove no code/document mismatch.

Inject candidate compile/configure failure; failure after active configure; restore failure; lost reply/timeout and restart. Compare real Par/OP, code/meta/document, pixels/last-good and receipt. Uncertain state blocks related writes until actual readback/recovery. indeterminate is not proof that last-good is preserved.

Exercise exact-payload retry/deduplication, altered-payload rejection, new sequence for cached Graph Undo, document-only delivery with compile count, cleanup failures without erasing confirmed success.

Reload Applied/upgrade on dirty Graph plus session draft: cancel, fetch failure, stale review tickets, changed base/revision, UI and non-UI load, whole-page reload, old pending responses. Preserve DEC001 DSH04/05/07/08/10.

Native project save uses only disposable unnamed/named/numbered-save cases with file location/hash and ACK evidence; do not Apply unsent drafts as a save side effect. Batch targets retain individual receipts/tickets.
gateTiming: G-LU-HOST-005 at first native commit/failure/readback, before extending publication
G-LU-NODE-001 first native backend then each promised leaf/overload/stage/platform
G-LU-DATA-006 native save; G-LU-UI-008/009 reload/lifetime composition
requirements.independentWork: Snapshot coherence, Updates scheduling/cache/diagnostic fences, typed receipt/readback contracts and controlled negative fixtures. OC09 withdrawal must not silently enable automatic generation; the specific operation-end trigger question remains scoped.

requirements.entry: S07 explicit existing Target, controls schema/readback and permissions. S08 is needed only for cross-publication/reload schema/receipt/lifetime branches.
runtime: Real TD Par/control style matrix for scalar/vector/matrix/texture and each claimed type; source/control/page/row shape edits, label/order/delete/Undo, Bind/Export/expression and externally owned references.

Group CAS validates shapeId/driverId/revision/type/writable at actual write boundary; value-only ABA is insufficient. Capture gesture before/accepted samples/seal/cancel/disconnect and actual own-domain receipts.

Only owned records/components change. Neighbor rows, external Bind/Export, RGB alpha, animation/current values and protected references survive edits and definition Undo. Pulse is request-identified, not fake undoable bool.
Native typed Undo must run on actual TD; portable Par fixtures do not substitute for G-LU-HOST-007.

All ten DEC-GRAPE-001 acceptance cases: Graph vs Host History isolation; >=10000 observations without Graph dirty/revision/Redo/echo; both stale-basis orderings and ABA; committed Graph Undo plus live divergence; domain focus/no fallback; UI/non-UI load/rebind/incarnation races; new conditional intent; retry/duplicate/changed-payload/unknown outcome/no-op; canonical save/reload.
gateTiming: G-LU-DATA-003 for every claimed TD/OS binding/type matrix
requirements.independentWork: Domain command dispatch, immutable mirror/no-echo model, receipt and ABA negative fixtures; no Mixed History coordinator, hidden mode or AT-S09-03 implementation.

requirements.entry: S07 preview Target/authority; no prior Apply required. S08 only for Apply capture-hold intersection.
runtime: Actual MAT/TOP preview candidate/current handoff, failed/cancelled switch, claim/takeover, source identity/Home behavior, stop/heartbeat/capture job cleanup and late frame fencing.

Actual PNG: MAT 512x512 alpha with two absolute frame advances and nonblocking readiness; TOP uses its preview output; cancellation/replacement avoids wrong-target GPU read. Record real GPU/cook/PNG separately from stream.
Viewer sections/styles/permissions and actual parameter expected-value write/readback; per-control native Undo/Redo and TOE reload support matrix. Unknown controls are not presumed supported.

Mouse focus/content-zoom normalized coordinates and capture release; actual touch: 6 CSS px single-finger threshold, two-finger pan/pinch locking, movement6/spread10 thresholds with spread>movement*1.5 pinch selection, three-finger/cancel/remainder release; Home-only allowed shortcut behavior.

Follow-size real encoder: even sizes bounded 64..1920 by64..1080, 350ms settling with no held pointer/paused state; unchanged size no resend, same peer/source and no Home; resize/Apply hold/stop/late frame boundedness.

Physical browser/device and LAN/remote media evidence for declared remote scope. Historical LAN/Tailscale delivery-link prerequisites remain removed; this does not replace intrinsic remote-preview evidence with localhost.
requirements.independentWork: Viewer descriptor UI, touch recognizer and extent algorithms, session/capture fencing on controlled fixtures; these are not real GPU/cook/media proof.

requirements.entry: S03 Graph-local subgraphs; S05 only material/texture/normal/source/helper families actually used by templates; S08 safe provisioning/commit/readback.
runtime: Four editable templates: Phong MAT Graph, PBR MAT Graph, Phong Material Textured, PBR Material Textured. Each independent identity/output and graph/resources survives save/reload.

Verify white and flat-normal fallback, independent texture overrides (textured variants9/10 maps), channel routing (alpha map R), exact alpha/point-color order, PBR0.08 reflectance/roughness floor0.0001, tangent/TBN and native finishing using capability variants/compositionSteps; real pixels/native helper overload/stage evidence is required.

Hash original authorized TOE/TOX packages; load copies in isolated projects, inventory embedded DAT/parameters/callbacks/storage/viewer network read-only and compare source hashes. New unknown behavior is new IR, not frozen rewrite.

Save actual output packages, exit fixture process, cold reopen in a fresh process with editor/manager absent, capture render/identity/resources; re-add manager and prove independence without old memory or legacy host links.
Absent/rejected native creation-menu provider leaves core template/Graph creation available with explicit unavailable.
gateTiming: G-LU-AUDIT-001 before complete embedded replacement claims
G-LU-NODE-001 for claimed native template helpers/platforms
requirements.independentWork: Versioned graph/template assets, neutral resource descriptors and pure graph-edit/persistence tests; no need to finish all391-node catalog first.

requirements.entry: S01 minimum flow; packaging can prepare alongside other slices, final profile evidence integrates only actually reviewed behavior.
runtime: Every declared Static Web, Node-hosted and Electron package must run actual S01 flow and provider availability/refusal paths with exact browser/runtime/package/version, permissions, storage and Host service matrix.

Actual cross-machine client/server/Host locality for files/window/Target; Node server local is not browser user local. Electron packaged renderer uses narrow bridge and does not import arbitrary Node/native APIs.

Separate three cases: external internet unavailable while host/assets remain; isolated TD fixture stopped while application assets remain; fresh browser profile/cache-empty first load. Avoid machine-wide firewall/cache changes or stopping existing user TD.
Typed unavailable keeps canonical editing/save valid, never guesses another target; cannot substitute unavailable for a profile's declared mandatory provider.
Embedded-host asset success is not PWA/first-load offline support. Real Electron package is not established by Node tests, existing Codex desktop runtime or a static Vite bundle.
gateTiming: G-DEPLOYMENT-CONFORMANCE first declared profile then each promised package/profile
requirements.independentWork: Static/Node service injection and package manifests, no-provider UI paths, import boundary checks and Electron bridge design; package/runtime execution remains later required.

sourceSliceContracts.name: 安全交付 Shader、保留 last-good 並讀回

runtimeIntegrationEvidence: 批次更新、宿主save文件位置、timeout及coldrestart另列明，不用fakeprovider全部覆蓋。
architectureConformanceChecks: receiver必在副作用前驗權限/epoch/sequence，read-onlyinspection不能產生write grant。

acceptanceTests.when: Prepare/commit A後改Graph為B，延遲與逆序回覆

acceptanceTests.when: 接受upgrade或Reload Applied時改base/revision、之後整頁reload

sourceSliceContracts.name: 即時參數、自訂控制與分域 Undo

prerequisiteOutputs.output: 明確Target、control schema/readback與對應權限生命期。既有Target的live控制不要求先Apply新shader。

conditionalPrerequisites.branch: 跨 publication/reload 的 binding schema 替換、conditional propagation 與 receipt/lifetime 競態（不含 deferred mixed chronology）
conditionalPrerequisites.output: 安全native publication/receipt/readback及Reload Applied邊界；只對此分支生效，不阻擋既有Target的live/native controls。

runtimeIntegrationEvidence: 真TD Par/style/Bind/Export/typedUndo、動畫排除、外部改動及load競態；CAS模型不是這些結果的替代。
architectureConformanceChecks: GraphHistory/HostValueHistory/NativeDefinitionHistory保持authority分域；command domain router不持全局chronology或hidden coordinator。
Graph Undo先發布canonical restore；後續conditional live write不新增Graph entry，Host失敗不補償Graph。
runtime mirror/receipt/basis不成GraphDocument/GraphHistory資料；觀察不echo、不建立application Undo。
所有實際寫入仍驗Host authority/CAS、load/epoch/incarnation/request identity與receiving-side fence。

acceptanceTests.when: 改UI值/取消gesture/斷線/重連
acceptanceTests.then: 預設不被覆蓋；CAS衝突明示；保留已接受狀態；Gesture收據/Undo不含他人動畫。

acceptanceTests.when: 改shape/頁/label/刪除再Undo
acceptanceTests.then: 定義與live值按各自owner恢復；不改鄰列/外部引用；typed nativeundo有實機證據。

acceptanceTests.when: 依已定次序Undo/Redo、timeout重試、await期間load新圖
acceptanceTests.then: 只在確認結果後推stack；idempotentreceipt不重做；晚回覆不mark/render新Graph。

originalAcceptance.when: 依已定次序Undo/Redo、timeout重試、await期間load新圖
originalAcceptance.then: 只在確認結果後推stack；idempotentreceipt不重做；晚回覆不mark/render新Graph。

acceptanceTests.meaning: Original unified claim remains verbatim and deferred; not executed or passed. Graph Undo does not await Host; confirmation rule remains only in Host/live domain.

acceptanceTests.name: Graph Undo is not TD history rewind
acceptanceTests.given: Canonical model was edited; TD performed an external operation/Undo; Graph History has an eligible edit.
acceptanceTests.when: Dispatch Graph Undo.
acceptanceTests.then: Canonical model restores through Graph History. TD-originated history cursor and external animation are not rewound. Any active-binding propagation is a new conditional write.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Host/live Undo is not Graph Undo
acceptanceTests.given: A Grape-originated Host/native/live operation has a valid receipt; canonical/default value and Graph history are captured.
acceptanceTests.when: Undo only the explicit Host/live domain.
acceptanceTests.then: Only owned eligible Host records change. Canonical/default value, Graph revision/dirty/history/redo stay unchanged.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: High-frequency observations are not editing transactions
acceptanceTests.given: Graph has a Redo branch and a known serialized snapshot; Host has external drivers.
acceptanceTests.when: Feed at least 10000 observations including animation and TD Undo readback.
acceptanceTests.then: Mirror/runtime basis updates correctly; no Graph or application Undo entries, Graph dirty/revision/redo changes, or echo writes. This bounded test is not a throughput claim.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Stale basis cannot be forced by Undo
acceptanceTests.given: An existing applicable Binding intent/receipt basis and canonical edit are available; Graph Undo would propagate a conditional live write.
acceptanceTests.when: Exercise both orders: (1) capture write basis then external change before commit; (2) external animation/TD Undo and mirror readback happen before Graph Undo starts. Change value/driver/shape/revision; include A-to-B-to-A values.
acceptanceTests.then: Invalidated applicable basis causes refusal/conflict; Graph Undo stays committed and Host external result remains. Latest mirror alone does not renew authority. No value-only equality shortcut, silent fresh-basis retry or force-write.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Live conflict does not roll back Graph Undo
acceptanceTests.given: Canonical 2-to-1 Undo commits; actual Host state has diverged.
acceptanceTests.when: Deliver conflict for the new conditional live write.
acceptanceTests.then: Canonical=1; Graph cursor already advanced and revision increased; no extra Graph entry/rollback. Host external actual value retained; Binding exposes divergence.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Ctrl+Z obeys command/editing domain
acceptanceTests.given: Canvas, committed Inspector, uncommitted text/IME draft, Host/live control, and no eligible/empty history domain can have focus.
acceptanceTests.when: Dispatch Ctrl+Z with newer edits available in a different domain.
acceptanceTests.then: Only explicit domain/local-draft semantics apply. No global-most-recent fallback or Panel-owned History. Draft editing creates no Graph entry until commit.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Old document/binding replies are inert
acceptanceTests.given: Native/live restore, Undo propagation or publication receipt is pending.
acceptanceTests.when: Load a new document via UI and non-UI entry, rebind to new epoch, or restart Target incarnation; then release each old response.
acceptanceTests.then: Old response cannot mutate new document, dirty, render, or Graph/Host History context. No lease/token revival. Receiver fences remain required; client discard does not prove physical remote cancellation.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Successful propagation is a new conditional intent
acceptanceTests.given: Active binding has valid expected basis and authority; model edit can Undo; repeat with no binding.
acceptanceTests.when: Commit Graph Undo, then complete conditional live write; observe concurrent artifact publication separately.
acceptanceTests.then: Graph restore completes first. Live path has new request/intent identity and does not append Graph History or replay old receipt. No binding yields zero Host calls. Publication preserves compatible actual values, never resets defaults to implement this propagation.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Own-domain confirmation/retry/no-op
acceptanceTests.given: A Host-domain Undo has valid receipt; capture its stack and unrelated Graph state.
acceptanceTests.when: Delay, reject, retry same payload, duplicate receipt, change reused payload, or make outcome indeterminate; exercise no-op/cancel/Redo.
acceptanceTests.then: Only confirmed own-domain success advances that stack. Same request+payload has no repeated side effect; changed payload rejected. Unknown outcome blocks related Host writes for readback. Already committed Graph Undo stands. Own-domain no-op preserves Redo; no shared global Redo.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceTests.name: Reload/save boundaries survive deferral
acceptanceTests.given: LC-UI-101 confirm/cancel/draft cases and restored canonical value exist; runtime differs.
acceptanceTests.when: Exercise cancel, fetch failure, accepted replacement, stale replies, and canonical save/reload.
acceptanceTests.then: Original reload confirmation/guard/failure requirements retained (G-LU-UI-008 not presumed solved). Successful load has new lifetime and reset session state; stale callbacks do not revive it. Save contains canonical value, not runtime mirror/leases/History/divergence; binding authority must be re-established.
acceptanceTests.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

minimumFixturePlan.suggestedInitialRuntime: TouchDesigner 2025.32820 Windows, separate instance; starting-point suggestion only, not a supported-platform decision

steps.action: Preparation only; later designated Implementer creates a new empty fixture root with an unpredictable run suffix under .verification/continuous-native-01/. No file created there by this scout.
steps.preconditions: Separate bounded assignment; normalize exact TD executable/build, temporary root, allowed process/ports/targets and action list. Existing PID12476 and all Legacy URLs excluded.

steps.action: Prepare a production native receiver/adapter and fixture bootstrap source under non-handoff production paths using public contract semantics. Target selection, error capture and cleanup are part of fixture setup.
steps.preconditions: One writer; reference classes cannot be copied as production foundation; implementation reviewed at exact commit.

steps.action: Launch a distinct TD instance with a blank/disposable project only after runtime-operation authority is bound. Record PID/path/TD app build/OS/GPU/driver/license capability and explicit fixture-root marker. Never reuse or stop the observed existing TD process.
steps.preconditions: Scout packet does not authorize launch. Gate text asks separately scoped TD operation authority. Coordinator reconciles existing run authority first; ask Human only for uncovered permission, physical operation or license prompt. Exact TD automation/launch mechanism is not verified here.

steps.action: Create one fixture-owned TOP Target and a minimal compileable constant-color artifact plus one live scalar, with distinct hostId/targetId/incarnation and no externally linked resources. Localhost-only receiver/explicit descriptor can be initial environment.
steps.preconditions: No discovery scan or endpoint guess; dedicated fixture-owned address/port must be selected by later harness and recorded, not borrowed from Legacy.

steps.action: Run S07 explicit connect/cancel/reconnect and receiver refusal cases, then S08 A prepare/commit/readback, value change during prepare, A/B ordering, same-request retry and failure injection before configure/after configure/restore. Capture actual native state and pixels before/after.
steps.preconditions: Real receiving-side fence and host-affine dispatch. Start with minimum scope; uncertain actual state stops dependent writes, not the whole product.

steps.action: Add a second disposable Target/identity for wrong-target and reincarnation cases, and a MAT branch only when needed to qualify stage/native helper/diagnostic behavior. Test UI/non-UI document load while old native replies are pending.
steps.preconditions: No full-catalog claim from one TOP. MAT must be proven separately before MAT preview/templates depend on it.
